# favseed

> One SVG in, an optimised favicon set out. A Node CLI (`npx favseed logo.svg --out public`), an Astro integration (`favseed/astro`), and this website, which runs the same SVG stage in the browser with nothing uploaded.

favseed writes one optimized `icon.svg` preserving animation and styling, a 48x48 PNG-backed `favicon.ico`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, and safe-zone-placed `icon-192.png`/`icon-512.png`, plus an optional `site.webmanifest`. Full builds select SVG precision against the source's static 512px appearance with a 1% error budget, retaining source geometry if rounded candidates fail. Each PNG and the ICO payload is the smallest encode that passes an accuracy bar (at most 1% of pixels off by more than 8/255, and an edge-weighted error limit), finished with Zopfli. `--effort fast` makes one quality-80 encode with no Zopfli; `--effort max` tries every candidate. `--quality` or `--colors` pins one setting instead. Browser and CLI share the pinned engine and pipeline and produce identical bytes for matching source/options. Processing stays local.

- [Generated benchmarks](https://github.com/cevdetch/favseed/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): bytes and accuracy over the test fixtures
